interface.title: Add a CAN interface
interface.description: Pick the CAN interface to add. Interfaces that are already added are not listed.

can.title: CAN interface {port}
can.description: Driver: {driver}. Every node on the bus must use the same bitrate. New interfaces start in listen-only mode.

data_description.listen_only: Never acknowledge or send: watch an existing bus without touching it. Turn it off to send, and on a bus where the only other node needs this host's acknowledgement.
data_description.restart_ms: 0 = stay in bus-off until the entry is reloaded.
data_description.filters: Only receive these IDs, comma separated: 123 (11-bit), 18FF50E5 (29-bit), 7E0/7F0 (ID/mask). Empty = everything.
data_description.event_filter: Received frames with these IDs fire woow_can_frame events and the event entity: 123, 18FF50E5, 7E0/7F0, 100-1FF, * = all. Empty = none (the panel's monitor still shows everything). Each event is written to the history database.
data_description.max_events_per_sec: Events beyond this rate are counted but not fired.

virtual.title: Create a virtual interface
virtual.description: A CAN interface without hardware (vcan), for trying the panel, automations and agents. Frames sent on it by any program on this host are seen by all others. It is re-created after the host restarts and deleted with the entry.

data_description.port: vcan followed by a number, e.g. vcan0.

error.bad_filter: Invalid filter. Use hex IDs, optionally ID/MASK, separated by commas.
error.bad_event_filter: Invalid ID list. Use hex IDs, ID/MASK, FROM-TO ranges or *, separated by commas.
error.bad_vcan_name: Use vcan followed by a number, e.g. vcan0.
error.vcan_failed: Could not create the virtual interface (the host kernel needs the vcan module).

abort.no_interfaces: No free CAN interface found. To try WOOW CAN without hardware, add a virtual interface.

describe.name: Describe WOOW CAN
describe.description: For AI agents: what this integration does, the frame notation, the workflow and the interfaces with their health. Call it first. Call it with return_response: true.

list_interfaces.name: List CAN interfaces
list_interfaces.description: The interfaces with state (error_active = healthy), bus load, error counters, drops and the last error frame. Call it with return_response: true.

get_monitor.name: Get the per-ID monitor
get_monitor.description: One row per CAN ID and direction: count, rate, period, latest data and how often the data changed. Call it with return_response: true.

interface.name: Interface
interface.description: Name (CAN0), interface (can0) or config entry id; empty = all.

get_trace.name: Get the frame trace
get_trace.description: Frames in time order, newest first, from the interface's buffer of recent frames. Call it with return_response: true.

interface.name: Interface
interface.description: Name (CAN0), interface (can0) or config entry id.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: rx = received, tx = sent from this host.

before.name: Before
before.description: Continue an earlier call: its next_before.

seconds.name: Last seconds
seconds.description: Only frames from the last this many seconds.

get_activity.name: Get the activity log
get_activity.description: Who sent what or changed what, newest first. Call it with return_response: true.

list_periodic.name: List periodic sends
list_periodic.description: The periodic sends with their state. Call it with return_response: true.

list_captures.name: List recordings
list_captures.description: Recorded candump log files. Call it with return_response: true.

send.name: Send CAN frame
send.description: Send one CAN / CAN FD frame, optionally waiting for a reply ID. Admin only; the interface must not be listen-only.

config_entry_id.name: Interface
config_entry_id.description: The CAN interface to send on.

interface.name: Interface name
interface.description: Instead of the entry: name (CAN0) or interface (can0).

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: The whole frame in cansend notation: 123#11223344, 18FF50E5#01, 456##1AABB (CAN FD). Instead of CAN ID and data.

data.name: Data
data.description: Hex bytes: up to 8 (classic) or 64 (CAN FD).

extended.name: Extended ID
extended.description: Force a 29-bit ID (default: decided by the ID length).

fd.name: CAN FD
fd.description: Send as a CAN FD frame (CAN FD must be on for the interface).

brs.name: Bit rate switch
brs.description: CAN FD: send the data phase at the data bitrate.

wait_id.name: Reply ID
wait_id.description: Return the first received frame with this ID (waits 1 s unless wait_ms is set).

wait_ms.name: Wait for reply
wait_ms.description: 0 = do not wait; without a reply ID any received frame counts.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why, in a few words; shown in the activity log.

save_periodic.name: Save a periodic send
save_periodic.description: Add or change a frame that is sent every period_ms. Saved sends are stopped after a restart. Admin only.

count.description: Stop after this many sends; 0 = until stopped.
